annotations.title: Hawaii trail, park and road alerts

description: Reported closures, cautions and access notices for Hawaii trails, parks, attractions and scenic roads, with source links and check dates where recorded. Scheduled windows can be expired with current access unconfirmed; reported status is not proof of current access or reopening. Use for questions like "is the Kalalau Trail open" or "what is closed on Kauai".

island.description: Optional island filter: oahu, maui, big-island, kauai, molokai or lanai.

query.description: Optional place or keyword, for example "Kalalau" or "Road to Hana".
